community_list_entries.name: PairPref: When Should Memory Guide the Answer? A Benchmark for Contextual Preference Use

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark of 1,227 situation pairs (45 preferences, 8 situation categories) testing whether a retrieved user-preference memory should be applied; preferences come as a 16-item memory list, with no multi-session history. No code/data URL given in paper.
